messages:
samir: quick heads-up — spotted an odd commit vs billing mismatch for a EU-heavy Dedicated customer. They committed a pooled throughput split (eu-west ~60%, us-west ~40%) but billing shows us-westx consuming ~70% of bursts last week and triggering overage charges even though total utilization stayed under the commit. anyone seen this pattern?

elaine: do we have per-region reservation accounting on that pool or is it global? if it's global smart-routing could be drifting traffic to us-west during eu congestion.

samir: pool is configured global with regional affinity weights (not hard pinned). i checked autoscaler events — during a brief eu-west network blip the autoscaler attached extra nodes in us-west. looks like commit ledger reconciliation failed during that window. cc infra-bot logs.

infra-bot: infra-bot: CommitLedger v2 — allocation delta detected. eu-west: -18% (reconciliation timeout), us-west-2: +22% (burst auto-attach). Incident ref: #INC-2026-042. Log excerpt: ```2026-02-11T03:12:14Z ERROR commit_ledger.apply(pool_id=pool-rw1, change=-3240) reconciliation timeout after 30s```

jon: if ledger reconciliation timed out, maybe the attach completed but we never persisted the pending allocation, so billing counted those as on-demand/burst in us-west. do we see on-demand lineitems for the same window?

maria: pulled billing export — confirmed. line items labelled `burst-attach.us-west-2` for 2026-02-11 03:12-03:25 (~2.4k token units). also saw fallback to `fallback-model:h2-small` during the failover window.

elaine: immediate mitigation idea: reconcile commit ledger retroactively and issue a customer credit for the window. long term: ensure pending allocations are persisted before autoscaler attaches nodes so we don't lose commit credits.

samir: i ran a staging dry-run with `prefer-regional-affinity: strict` and induced packet loss in eu-west — that prevented cross-region fallback but increased p50 latency for a subset of shards. more pragmatic fix: persist the pending allocation (commit reserve) before finalizing auto-attach.

jon: +1. also let's emit a `commit_crediting_latency` histogram and alert if >500ms. that will catch timeouts before we hit billing.

maria: :thumbsup: i'll open the billing case and draft credit wording. recommend we inform the customer proactively with a short explanation and timeline for remediation.

elaine: i'll spike a PR to persist pre-attach allocation this afternoon. need a small DB schema change to mark allocations `pending_persisted` and a short migration. estimate: 1 day to spike, 3 days for review/testing if no surprises. samir can help with the test harness.

samir: happy to help with the tests. maria please send me the billing draft and i'll add a technical appendix. for now i've given the customer a provisional credit pending our investigation to avoid escalation.

ops-desk: ops-desk: noted. created ticket INFRA-6521 to track: ledger persist spike, metric+alert, billing case & issued provisional credit. tentative ETA: patch staged for next Wednesday's deploy window.

jon: should we also add a replay job that can recompute creditable allocations for any pool for a given time window? would make credits deterministic.

elaine: yes — add a `recompute_commit_window(pool_id, start_ts, end_ts)` maintenance job. i'll include it in the PR.

maria: thanks all. i'll keep the customer updated and attach logs from the billing export.

samir: closing loop here — i'll post the postmortem once we validate the ledger fix in staging. thanks everyone.
